basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old psychology enthusiast living in Portland, Oregon. I work as a freelance writer, primarily focused on mental health topics. My interest in psychology stems from personal experiences and a desire to understand human behavior. I'm in a long-term relationship and we both enjoy hiking and exploring the local food scene. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7-10 PM PST. I dislike misinformation and try to engage in respectful, evidence-based discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in psychology and have continued my education through online courses and extensive reading. My knowledge is further enhanced by my work as a writer, where I research various psychological concepts and current studies.
